racer-streak.desc: long thin pale racers stretched dead straight with a tan side stripe, darting fast with speed dashes; the chain is a striped streak with speed lines

mirage-shimmer.desc: heat-mirage wavy lines with a dotted ghost racer wavering inside, flickering out

horn-sink.desc: sand vipers shimmying side to side down into the sand until only the two little horns and the eyes show; the chain is a sand ridge running under the sand with the horns poking up

scale-rasp.desc: C-shaped coils rubbing their saw-edged scales together, rasp ticks flying off the open side

scree-viper.desc: rock-blotched grey vipers coiled among pebbles, the flat head lifting to taste the air; the chain slithers a blotched body along the edge, pebbles kicked aside

ledge-slab.desc: three stacked stone slabs like a ledge wall with lichen flecks, a flat viper head sliding out of the crack

hot-scree.desc: sun-hot rocks glowing at the base with a viper draped over them, heat wiggles rising

sat-rock.desc: a flat rock pressed down from above, then cracking as the viper hidden under it bites up, white fangs out

vine-sway.desc: vine-thin green snakes held out stiff from the edge like twigs, swaying in a breeze, pointed snout and keyhole eye, a tongue flick; the chain is a thin stiff body bridging the gap

keyhole-gaze.desc: big golden snake eyes with a horizontal keyhole pupil sliding to look, a sighting groove ahead

tendril-hide.desc: vine stems with curled tendrils and leaves; a thin snake lies along each, its eye showing now and then

calf-wobble.desc: gangly camel calves with fluffy humps, stilt legs and knobbly knees splaying as they wobble; the chain wobble-walks leaving two-toed pad prints

hump-fluff.desc: fluffy hump mounds with knobbly bumps, fluff tufts waving on top

lash-blink.desc: big calf eyes with long lashes closing against streaming sand

cud-spit.desc: floppy lips spitting a green cud blob that flies with a dribble and splats flat

dingo-lope.desc: lean ginger dingoes with pale socks, pricked ears and white-tipped bushy tails, loping; the chain lopes along in a puff of red dust, paw prints behind

dingo-snap.desc: a ginger muzzle in close-up gaping with white teeth, then snapping shut with snap ticks

howl-rise.desc: sitting dingoes with muzzles raised, howl arcs rising one after another

red-dust-roll.desc: a dingo rolling on its back in red dust, paws up, a ring of red dust around

spot-lope.desc: spotted hyenas with sloping backs, big round-eared heads and dark muzzles, loping; the chain lopes along carrying a bone, paw prints behind

giggle-burst.desc: grinning hyena heads with mouths open on a laugh, little hee carets bouncing up beside them

bone-snap.desc: knobbed bones bending, cracking and snapping in two with splinters (hyenas crush bone)

mane-raise.desc: grey striped hyenas whose long black-tipped mane rises tall along the back, doubling their size; the chain trots along dragging a bone, a drag line behind

mane-crest.desc: rows of long grey mane hairs with black tips rising out of the edge as they bristle

tail-trot.desc: grey barrel warthogs with warty heads, upturned tusks and a bristle mane, trotting with the tail straight up and its tuft flicking; the chain trots with the tail flag up

tusk-hook.desc: a warty face close-up, curved tusks hooking up and out, then lifting with lift ticks

mud-fling.desc: a snout shoving mud, clods flung outward in a widening arc

wire-bristle.desc: tufts of long wiry bristles springing out of the edge with tawny forked tips, wart bumps at the base

calf-stampede.desc: rust bison calves galloping head-down with shoulder humps and oversized woolly heads; the chain is three calves thundering in a row with a dust cloud behind

head-plant.desc: a huge woolly calf head lowered nose to the ground, front hooves planted, dust kicked up

hoof-dust.desc: churned dust clouds blooming with dark hooves and a tail kicking out of them

bellow-call.desc: calf heads thrown up bellowing, a breath puff and bellow arcs swelling out of the open mouth

ratel-duo.desc: two honey badgers, grey-white mantle over a black body, trotting nose to tail; the chain is the pair trotting one after the other leaving claw scratches

loose-skin.desc: a ratel twisting round inside its loose skin, the mantle staying put while the black body turns under it

dig-claw.desc: three long pale digging claws raking out of the edge on a black paw, soil flecks flying

honey-dig.desc: torn chunks of wild comb with honey welling and dripping, a ratel claw hooked in, bees buzzing round

cub-stripe-face.desc: little striped badger-cub faces (white face, black stripes over the eyes) jostling and chirring; the chain is three cubs rolling along in a heap

cub-pile.desc: three badger cubs piled in a wobbling heap, the top cub tipping over

sett-mouth.desc: dug-in sett entrances, a cub face peering out of the dark arch, claws on the rim, soil crumbs kicked up

burr-clump.desc: hooked tan burr balls snagged with tufts of fur, the hooks turning

stink-rump.desc: dark stink badgers with a white back stripe that raise the rump and fire a musk jet; the chain trundles leaving a wavering reek line

reek-haze.desc: three wavy yellow-green stench lines rising with a fly circling them

snore-curl.desc: a badger curled asleep, white stripe curving round, Zs drifting up

molehill-heave.desc: molehills heaving up and a velvet mole pushing out snout and pink spade hands; the chain is a mole run ridging along the edge, leaving molehills

spade-claw.desc: big pink spade hands with five white claws raking outward, soil flicked behind

soil-clod.desc: lumps of soil flung out, crumbling, root threads hanging off

star-nose.desc: the pink star of 22 feelers round a dark snout, twitching open and shut very fast, waterline dashes under it

bubble-sniff.desc: the star nose underwater blowing a bubble and sniffing it back in

buck-teeth.desc: wrinkled pink mole-rat faces with two huge cream incisors over the lips, chattering; the chain is a conga of naked mole-rats nose to tail

molerat-rush.desc: naked mole-rats side-on running nose to tail, teeth first

colony-heap.desc: three pink mole-rats huddled in a warm heap, the top one shuffling round

tunnel-call.desc: tunnel holes with a pink snout and incisors poking out and chirp marks rising

gold-sand-swim.desc: eyeless gold moles half sunk in sand, leathery nose pad first, an iridescent sheen sweeping their backs; the chain swims under the sand with its back breaking the surface

gold-curl.desc: a golden mole curled in a velvet ball with a rainbow-gold sheen running round it

blind-lunge.desc: a blind gold wedge head lunging nose-pad first with vibration arcs spreading ahead

grain-rat.desc: brown barn rats with long pink tails scurrying, a grain kernel in the teeth; the chain runs the edge dropping kernels

grain-nip.desc: gold grain kernels nipped: a bite notch, then split with chaff flying

plank-squeeze.desc: a rat flattening itself through the gap between two barn planks and out the other side

hay-stack.desc: little haystacks with straws sticking out and a pink rat tail swishing from under them

wet-fur-shake.desc: shaggy wet marsh rats with blunt snouts and spiky fur, shaking off a spray of drops; the chain swims stop to stop, shaking a ring of drops at each

bank-burrow.desc: muddy banks with a round burrow at the waterline, water lapping, eyes glinting inside

reed-gnaw.desc: reed stems cut at a slant by gnawing, straw chips flying, the cut top falling over

reed-shove.desc: three reeds with brown cattail heads leaning outward as they are shoved over

trinket-trade.desc: big-eared pack rats with a stuffed cheek carrying a glinting trinket; the chain drops one trinket and runs off with a shinier one

trinket-hoard.desc: stolen trinkets (coin, key, bottle cap, spoon) glinting in turn

stuffed-cheek.desc: a big-eared pack rat face with its cheeks stuffing out wider and wider

stick-midden.desc: criss-cross stick middens with a cactus bit and a shiny thing on top, a glint wandering over them

burr-pup.desc: fluffy grey pups curled into balls with burrs stuck all over, tumbling

bramble-arch.desc: bramble canes arching over the edge with thorns, leaves and blackberries, pup eyes blinking underneath

jackal-lope.desc: rangy sandy jackals with tall ears and a dark saddle, pale thorns in the coat, loping; the chain lopes along leaving paired paw prints

scrub-lick.desc: a jackal muzzle lapping with a pink tongue, scrub leaf bits lifting off

thorn-jaw.desc: long narrow jaws with thorn-pale teeth opening and snapping shut with a crack spark

cactus-dodge.desc: prickly-pear pads with spine dots and a red fruit, jackal ear tips dodging behind them

jackal-sit.desc: jackals sitting tall and still, tail round the feet, eyes closing slowly and opening again

leaf-hat.desc: round masked tanuki faces with a green leaf on the head, whiskers bristling and blinking; the chain poofs into a leaf, flutters along and pops back out as a tanuki

belly-drum.desc: a round pale tanuki belly drummed by two dark paws, a beat ring popping out on every beat

leaf-poof.desc: a green leaf that vanishes in a white poof cloud, a masked face peeking out of the smoke

belly-roll.desc: a round tanuki rolled into a furry ball, the dark mask band turning with it

stump-pose.desc: a cut tree stump with rings and a leaf on top, a striped tail peeking out and two eyes blinking open in the bark

tail-flag.desc: upright ringed coati tails sticking out like flags, tips curling, canopy leaves falling; the chain is a band of coatis marching tails-up

ring-screen.desc: three ringed tails crossed into a picket screen, the dark and pale bands pulsing

log-cover.desc: a mossy fallen log with long coati snouts poking out from under it in turn

snout-probe.desc: long upturned coati snouts probing outward, the tip twitching, soil crumbs flicked

pink-face.desc: pink macaque faces in a grey-brown fur ring, flashing an open-mouth threat and raised brows; the chain is the troop bounding on all fours

cheek-pouch.desc: a macaque face with bulging cheek pouches that dump out seeds and fruit scraps

hot-spring-huddle.desc: two macaque heads in steaming water with snow on their crowns, steam curls rising

quick-hand.desc: pink-palmed monkey hands with fingers spread, snatching shut

capuchin-cap.desc: cream capuchin faces under a dark cap, grinning cheekily, canopy leaves falling; the chain runs off along the edge holding a stolen gold button up

pocket-dip.desc: a stitched pocket, a small dark hand dipping in and coming out with a glinting coin

fruit-bomb.desc: round orange fruit with a leaf lobbed in an arc, splatting with juice

canopy-perch.desc: a leafy branch with a capuchin hanging under it by its curled tail, swinging

button-snatch.desc: shiny four-hole buttons on threads, a glint crossing them

tabby-tail.desc: thick blunt grey tabby tails with dark rings and a black tip lashing side to side, grass fringe; the chain is the wildcat stalking low and pouncing

fur-bristle.desc: an arched tabby back with the fur standing up in spikes

flat-ears.desc: a wildcat face with amber eyes, ears going from up to flat back with a fanged hiss

cat-claw.desc: a cat paw with hooked claws sprung, three curved slash marks trailing it

ear-tuft.desc: caracal heads with tall ears ending in long black tufts, flicking in turn; the chain leaps in one high arc into a burst of feathers

bird-swat.desc: a small bird flying up and a tawny paw leaping to swat it, feathers bursting

dusk-rest.desc: a caracal lying low in the grass before an orange half sun, ear tufts twitching

scrub-bush.desc: dry thorny scrub bushes with two black ear tufts poking up above them

fish-scoop.desc: a webbed paw scooping a silver fish out of the water with a splash, waterline rocking; the chain is the fishing cat wading with ripple rings at each step

wet-coat.desc: a stocky spotted back half under water, drops beading and running off it

spray-shake.desc: a spotted fur tuft whipping side to side, a widening ring of water drops flung off

webbed-paw.desc: webbed paws flicking outward, toes spread with water-blue webbing, claws hooked, a drop flicked off

otter-cat.desc: long low plain-coated jaguarundis with small round ears and a long tail, slipping along like otters; the chain slides on with a dark streak behind

river-slip.desc: a slick wet streak, a plain dark back slipping into the water and a splash ring opening

grass-slip.desc: tall bank grass parting to show a plain dark back slipping between, then closing

shadow-cross.desc: a dark low silhouette sliding past, only two eyes glinting now and then

rosette-cub.desc: two round spotted jaguar cubs play-wrestling, swapping who is on top, paws batting; the chain is two cubs chasing each other

big-paw.desc: oversized cub paws, a big pink pad and four toes spreading as they bat out, a rosette on the leg

tail-chase.desc: a spotted cub curled in a circle chasing its own stubby tail, spinning

bootlace.desc: a white bootlace bow with dark aglets tugged loose by a spotted paw until it dangles

cub-ball.desc: fluffy brown bear cubs curled into balls, ears, face and paws turning with the roll; the chain rolls downhill along the edge bouncing over bumps

honey-paw.desc: a paw pulled out of a honeycomb with golden honey dripping from it

fern-hide.desc: two fern fronds parting to show a round cub head with round ears peeking between

sun-crescent.desc: black sun bear heads with a pale gold muzzle and the gold chest crescent glowing like a rising sun; the chain is the long pink tongue unrolling along the edge with a honey drop on the tip

bark-claw.desc: a black paw with four long pale sickle claws ripping a strip of bark off

tree-hug.desc: a tree trunk with a black bear pressed to it, arms wrapped round, peeking out one side then the other

snout-sniff.desc: a pale gold muzzle snuffling with scent lines curling in, termites scattering

long-tongue.desc: a black muzzle at a hole in the bark, the long pink tongue reaching in and out, honey on the tip

fisher-bound.desc: long dark-brown fishers with grizzled heads and long bushy tails bounding in arcs, back arching; the chain bounds in three arcs leaving paired prints

fisher-quillslide.desc: fans of cream porcupine quills with dark tips bristling, a fisher nose sliding in underneath

fisher-treedrop.desc: bark trunks with a fisher coming down head first, hind feet turned back to grip

fisher-quillflip.desc: a quill-ball porcupine tipped over onto its back, pale belly and little feet up, then back again

wolverine-stripe.desc: stout dark wolverine cubs with a cream stripe down the flank and a pale brow, shoving and snarling; the chain charges through snow, clods flying

wolverine-snowball.desc: a cub rolled up in a snowball, a paw, the striped back and the tail poking out as it turns

wolverine-snarl.desc: a wolverine cub face with a pale brow band and round ears snapping open on white teeth

wolverine-boot.desc: a stolen camp boot shaken side to side, laces flapping, bite holes in the leather

pangolin-walk.desc: pangolins walking upright on their hind legs, domed bodies of overlapping scales, tails held out; the chain rolls as a scale ball and uncurls at the end

pangolin-ball.desc: a pangolin rolled into a ball of overlapping scales, the scale tips flaring out sharp

pangolin-tail.desc: a thick scaly tail swinging out from the edge and whacking, an impact star at the end of the swing

pangolin-mound.desc: termite mounds with holes, a long pink tongue flicking into one, red ants scattering

tamandua-vest.desc: pale tamanduas in a black vest, long tube snout first, prehensile tail curling; the chain clambers along leaving a faint musk haze

tamandua-hook.desc: a forepaw with three cream claws, the middle one a huge hook, raking outward

tamandua-hug.desc: a tamandua hugging a vertical branch, vest showing, snout up, tail wrapped round below

tamandua-tongue.desc: a long thin pink tongue flicking out of a tube snout and back, ants stuck to it

tamandua-tailhang.desc: a tamandua hanging from a branch by its tail with its arms spread wide in the threat pose, claws out

roe-bound.desc: slim russet roebucks with short three-point antlers bounding, white rump patch flashing; the chain bounds in two high arcs leaving slot prints

roe-antler.desc: a russet head lowered, two short three-point antlers with pearled bases jabbing outward

roe-antlerlock.desc: two bucks with antlers locked, heads pushing against each other, straining to and fro

roe-bracken.desc: russet bracken fronds with the fiddlehead uncurling, a hoof stamping down on them

roe-twinfawn.desc: twin white-spotted fawns curled side by side in the bracken, ears twitching in turn

goatkid-boing.desc: small white goat kids with horn buds boinging straight up on stiff legs, pebbles knocked loose; the chain boings from rock ledge to rock ledge

goatkid-heap.desc: one goat kid standing on another kid's back, wobbling

goatkid-ledge.desc: grey rock ledges with a kid perched on top, a pebble falling off

goatkid-butt.desc: two kid heads butting, horn buds meeting, an impact star on contact

yakcalf-shag.desc: shaggy yak calves plodding, a long fur fringe swaying to the ground, wide cream horns; the chain is three calves in file, the leader puffing breath

yakcalf-skirt.desc: curtains of long shaggy fur strands swaying, frost on the tips

yakcalf-breath.desc: a muzzle blowing a steaming breath cloud into the cold, bleat marks rising

yakcalf-horns.desc: a shaggy calf head front-on with wide cream horns curving out, lowered and shoving

snowleo-tail.desc: huge thick smoky tails swishing in an S, dark rings and a pale tip; the chain dashes along with the tail streaming behind in a long wave

snowleo-cub.desc: chubby rosetted snow leopard cubs crouching, then stretching out in a leap

snowleo-crag.desc: a grey crag with the cub curled flat on it, the thick tail wrapped over its nose, an ear flicking

snowleo-paw.desc: huge fluffy paws swatting out, dark toe pads, claws out on the swing

foxkit-den.desc: a snowy den mound with a dark hole, round-eared fox kits popping up one and two at a time; the chain is two kits tumbling out and rolling over each other

foxkit-dive.desc: an arctic fox mouse-pouncing: crouch, arc up, nose-dive into the snow with hind legs and tail sticking up

foxkit-yip.desc: a round-eared kit face yipping, mouth open, chirp marks rising one by one

whiteout-eyes.desc: almost invisible white foxes: only two black eyes and a black nose show, the outline flickering in the snow; the chain is a blizzard band with the three dots travelling inside

whiteout-jaws.desc: jaws snapping out of a snow mound: only the dark mouth, white teeth and black eyes show

whiteout-drift.desc: a snow drift ridge with two ear tips and a black nose cutting through it like a fin, snow spraying ahead

kit-pair-romp.desc: two russet fox kits with tall dark-tipped ears play-fighting: side by side, one crouches, pounces on the other, both tumble; snow sifts on the run; the chain is the two kits leapfrogging along the edge

kit-den.desc: den mouths in an earth bank, two pairs of ear tips and blinking eyes peering out of the dark

kit-brush-tail.desc: bushy white-tipped fox-kit tails curled over the edge, the fur fluffing out

kit-ear-nip.desc: a kit nipping its sibling's ear tip and tugging, a tiny yelp mark

fennec-ears.desc: a tiny cream fennec face under two huge pink-lined ears that swivel to listen; a sand ripple drifts along the run; the chain trots over the dunes with the ears bobbing under a moon glint

fennec-curl.desc: a fennec curled asleep, ears folded flat, the black-tipped tail over its nose, Zs rising

fennec-sand-curtain.desc: curtains of sand fanned up by two digging forepaws, the grains hanging in arcs

fennec-ear-ping.desc: fennec ears snapping up at a sound, listening arcs spreading from both ear tips

frost-hare-bound.desc: white hares with black ear tips bounding: sit, stretch, land in a frost spray; snow sifts on the run; the chain bounds in three arcs leaving Y-shaped hare tracks with a frost sparkle

hare-hind-kick.desc: a hare's big hind foot kicking straight out of the edge, a snow puff where it strikes

hare-zigzag.desc: a white hare jinking left and right in sharp zigzags, snow kicked up

hare-thump.desc: a hind foot stamping flat on the snow, shock rings spreading on both sides

hare-frost-breath.desc: a twitching hare nose breathing out a ring of frost that blooms, an ice crystal in it

hare-form.desc: a grey-brown mountain hare pressed into its form (a scraped hollow), ears laid back, grass tufts each side, the eye blinking; the chain lopes uphill leaving pale big-foot prints and nipped grass

hare-clover.desc: three-leaf clovers on their stems, a hare mouth nibbling a leaf away, bits floating up

hare-hollow-nap.desc: a hare napping as a round loaf in a hollow, ears folded flat along its back, breathing, a Z rising

hare-lope.desc: grey-brown mountain hares with big pale feet, loping in low strides

sail-ears.desc: huge sunlit jackrabbit ears, pink with red veins, one flicking over above a lean face; the chain sprints low and straight with a dust streak and the ears flick up at the end

jackrabbit-scrub.desc: grey-green thorny desert scrub with two tall ear tips poking up behind it, twitching

jack-sprint.desc: a lean long-legged jackrabbit at full stretch, ears laid back, dust off its hind feet

grump-face.desc: round black-capped orange lemmings scowling with puffed cheeks, teeth bared, an anger mark popping; the chain stomps along under its own little rain cloud

grumble-cloud.desc: small dark storm clouds muttering, a rumble zigzag under them, rain dots falling

lemming-snow-dig.desc: a lemming bum-up with its head buried in snow, snow chunks flung back

sulk-stare.desc: two narrowed slit eyes glaring out of a black-capped fur ball, red glare dashes reaching out

pika-call.desc: round tailless grey-brown pikas with round ears calling "eep", call marks flying; scree pebbles along the run; the chain scampers with a mouthful of hay and a flower, dropping stalks

pebble-pitch.desc: rounded scree stones with a lichen spot, spinning, a dotted flight line behind

pika-haypile.desc: bunches of grass stalks and flower heads (the pika's winter hay) bristling out of the edge, a flower nodding

pika-rock.desc: a pika sitting on a lichen-spotted boulder, turning its head left, front, right

marmot-stand.desc: a fat golden marmot standing tall with a dark face mask and pale belly, then dropping its whole weight into a squashed sit; the chain waddles like a barrel with a dust thud at each step

marmot-whistle.desc: a standing marmot with its mouth open in a sharp whistle, white whistle marks flying

marmot-belly-flop.desc: a marmot belly-flopped flat with its limbs splayed, dust puffing out both sides on impact

marmot-turf-shove.desc: slabs of turf shoved along by two fat paws, a crack opening in the ground behind

glacier-cub-face.desc: round blue-white cub faces with tiny round ears and frost crystals on the crown, blinking; snow sifts on the run; the chain belly-slides along a glossy ice streak with sparkles

cub-belly-slide.desc: a round cub sliding on its belly, paws stretched forward, white ice streak lines behind

cub-ice-skid.desc: a cub skidding on all fours with its legs splayed, ice chips spraying ahead

cub-frost-fluff.desc: the cub fluffed into a round fur ball, frosty tufts bristling all round, two eyes peeking

velvet-bud.desc: fuzzy brown reindeer calf faces with two velvet antler buds and a cream muzzle, lowering to butt; the chain is three calves trotting nose to tail with cloven prints and knee-click marks

calf-huddle.desc: three calves huddled rump to rump in the snow, cream rumps, warm breath steaming up

calf-bleat.desc: a calf muzzle bleating, soft arcs and warm breath rising from it

thistle-head.desc: thistle heads: spiny green bulbs with a swaying purple brush, down seeds lifting off; the chain is a thistle head tumbling in the wind shedding down

thistle-down.desc: thistle-down seeds: a dark seed under a white parachute of hairs, drifting and opening

thistle-needle.desc: spiny leaf darts with purple shafts and green side spikes, white point first

thistle-sprout.desc: forked tan roots digging down under a soil line while a green shoot pushes up and opens a purple bud

thistle-heap.desc: a mound of crossed spiny thistle leaves with purple heads on top, the spine tips bristling

thistle-whip.desc: a spiny thistle stem lashing in an arc with a purple head on the tip

nettle-lurk.desc: a hunched green lurker with nettle stalks on its back and yellow eyes low at the front; the chain creeps low past three stalks that lean aside

nettle-hairs.desc: a serrated leaf strip with a fringe of fine stinging hairs hanging off it, glinting tips swaying

nettle-stem.desc: square nettle stems with paired serrated leaves at the nodes and hairs on the stem, rustling

nettle-noose.desc: a nettle stem bent into a loop that pulls tight, leaves on the loop, hairs glinting

nettle-welt.desc: a serrated nettle leaf brushing past and white welts on red rings popping up behind it

nettle-stench.desc: a cut nettle stalk with a pale wound, two wavy yellow-green stink lines curling up out of it

nettle-eyes.desc: a pocket of shadow between two nettle stalks with a pair of yellow eyes in it, blinking

cactus-walk.desc: round ribbed barrel cacti with cream spines and a pink flower crown, waddling on stubby feet; the chain waddles along leaving two-dot prints in the sand

cactus-spine.desc: long cream cactus spines with a gold point jutting out of green areoles, trembling

cactus-water.desc: a cut wedge of cactus with pale wet flesh, a blue water drop welling up out of it

cactus-roll.desc: a barrel cactus on its side, ribs, spines and pink crown turning round as it rolls

cactus-bloom.desc: a pink crown flower opening on a green knob, gold pollen puffing out when it is fully open

cactus-hide.desc: a barrel cactus sunk into the sand to its middle, only the ribbed top and its spines showing, the spines bristling

willo-lure.desc: pale cold teardrop flames with a white core bobbing over the bog, the tail curling like a beckoning finger; the chain bobs ahead of a line of footprints that sink into the mud

willo-flicker.desc: marsh lights that wink out and come back a little to the side, never where you look

willo-flame.desc: three tongues of pale cold flame licking up over a dark scorch, white tips flickering

willo-lantern.desc: little dark-framed lanterns with a cold light inside, swinging, a glow ring pulsing out

willo-tendril.desc: wavering half see-through filaments of pale light reaching out of the edge and curling at the tip

willo-spores.desc: clusters of three glowing spores circling each other, little halos winking

foxfire-stump.desc: rotten stumps with jagged tops, green foxfire patches pulsing on the wood in turn; the chain is glowing mycelium creeping along the ground with a cap clump at its tip

foxfire-punk.desc: crumbs of soft rotten punkwood with glowing green rims, tumbling

foxfire-caps.desc: clumps of three glowing mushroom caps on pale stems, the gills lighting up one cap at a time

foxfire-spores.desc: puffs of glowing spores swelling open, curling a beckoning wisp when fully open

foxfire-mycel.desc: glowing mycelium knots: forked threads spreading from a bright node

stormwisp-ball.desc: blue-white balls of lightning with a white core and crackling zig tendrils, drifting; the chain drifts along with a jagged bolt flickering back to the start

stormwisp-bolt.desc: forked zigzag bolts with a white core striking outward, the jags shifting each frame

stormwisp-rain.desc: raindrops drawn upward with a streak trailing below them, a white glint

stormwisp-squall.desc: a small grey-blue cloud with a slanting curtain of rain streaks driven under it

stormwisp-spark.desc: crackling sparks that change shape every frame: plus, cross, jag, wink

squelch.desc: slow wet raise, squash on landing that recovers through the wiggle, slime puddle spreads

hop.desc: double hop on the way up, a small re-bounce after the click, dust puffs

thud.desc: fast heavy raise, squash and a 1 px shake on landing, dust

flutter.desc: slow floating raise with side sway, soft landing, two powder motes fall

skitter.desc: quick raise with a tiny side jitter, leg ticks at the sides

scuttle.desc: slides in sideways like a crab, sand dots behind

glide.desc: low slide in from the left, almost no lift, a streak behind

plop.desc: drops from higher, squash, a ring splashes out at the base

bob.desc: bobs on the way up as if floating, a ripple ring on landing

tumble.desc: rolls in (a rotation unwinds during the raise), dust arc

march.desc: steps up in 2 px steps, crumbs at the base

swarm.desc: dots converge onto the spot and the piece fades in out of them

pounce.desc: crouch, then a high quick leap, speed lines below

burrow.desc: rises up out of the ground (comes from below), a dirt mound kicks out

hover.desc: hangs above longer with a small bob and a stipple shadow, then drops

trundle.desc: very slow heavy raise, deep squash, dust

layouts.lance: shoot along the edge in one line
layouts.fall: drop off the edge and fall
layouts.hold: line up along the edge and hold

theme.notes: Ghost slug: a pale see-through cave slug with a faint glow inside; it fades in and out and breathes cold cave air.

creatures.name: Luna Moth
creatures.art: huge pale green wings, long tails

theme.notes: Luna moth: huge pale green wings with purple leading edges and eyespots, long trailing tails, flying by moonlight.
Earwig matron: a big chestnut earwig mother guarding and licking a clutch of pale eggs; shares the earwig forceps (pincer-snap) in her palette.
Garden orb spider: a round tan spider sitting at the hub of a dewy wheel web; it waits, drops on a dragline and wraps its catch.

creatures.name: Fishing Spider
creatures.art: long banded legs, standing on water

theme.notes: Fishing spider standing on the water film: long banded legs splayed, a dimple ring under every foot; it darts, dives and snatches minnows.
Paper wasps: slim amber wasps that fly with long legs dangling, guarding an open grey paper comb.
Hornet sentry: big orange-brown hornets with dark eyes pacing at the round door of a scalloped paper nest.
A dark teal-green bog leech that loops along sucker to sucker in murky water, latches on and drinks until it is fat; slime strings everywhere.
A boot-length, black, glossy, ridged leech of the deep mire: its huge back heaves up out of the bog like a log, hooks in and hauls in the rain.
A big olive bullfrog of the bog with a yellow throat: it whips a long pink tongue, booms a deep croak from a huge throat sac, puffs itself up round and gulps anything that fits.

creatures.name: Cane Toad
creatures.art: dry warty skin, big eye glands

theme.notes: A heavy dry warty cane toad with big bulging glands behind its eyes that squirt milky toxin; it sits on night roads under the moon and hops aside, never far.
A brown barn rat with a long pink tail living in the grain store and the hay: it gnaws, squeezes through any gap between planks and makes off with the grain.
A blunt-snouted marsh rat with thick fur that is always wet, living in a bank burrow at the waterline among the reeds; it shakes off spray wherever it stops.
A velvet-grey tunnel mole of field and forest that is mostly seen as molehills: the ground heaves, a pink snout and two big pink spade hands push out, and it is gone again.

creatures.name: Star-nosed Mole
creatures.art: pink star of feelers on nose

theme.notes: A dark wetland mole with a pink star of 22 feelers on its nose, touching everything many times a second; underwater it smells by blowing a bubble and sniffing it back.
A colony of pink, wrinkled naked mole-rats: huge cream incisors outside the lips, running nose to tail through their tunnels and sleeping in a warm heap.
Clever black carrion crow on fields and crags: hops two-footed with a sly pale eye, mobs in a cawing gang and steals hats; aims two ways at once.

creatures.name: Magpie Mob
creatures.art: black and white, long blue-green tail

theme.notes: A noisy gang of black-and-white magpies with long blue-green tails cocking up and down; they chatter and pinch anything shiny.

A walking clump of field thistle from grassland and mountain pasture: spiny green bulbs topped with purple brush flowers, leaves edged in spines, and in the wind it sheds clouds of white thistle down; it roots deep and comes back wherever a scrap of root is left.

creatures.name: Nettle Lurker
creatures.art: hunched green, stalks and stinging hairs

theme.notes: A hunched green thing that lurks in the nettle beds of forest and wetland: square stalks with serrated leaves grow out of its back, its whole hide is furred with fine stinging hairs that glint, and two yellow eyes watch from the stalk shadows before it springs; anything that brushes past comes away in white welts.

creatures.name: Bombardier Beetle
creatures.art: shiny blue-black, orange head, steaming tail

theme.notes: Bombardier beetle: orange head, shiny blue-black shell, a tail turret that swings round and fires boiling steam with a pop.

The marsh light of the wetland: a pale cold teardrop flame with a white heart that bobs just out of reach over the bog, curling its tail like a beckoning finger; it carries a little lantern glow, burns without heat, winks out when you look at it, and leads travellers off the path into the mud.

creatures.name: Foxfire Wisp
creatures.art: green glow around a rotten stump

theme.notes: Foxfire: the green glow that lives in a rotten forest stump, fungal light in soft punkwood. Patches of cold green pulse in turn on the wood, glowing mushroom caps grow from it, and pale mycelium threads creep out under the leaf litter, lighting up as they spread.
A pale grey, glossy, round-pupilled grassland snake that lives under warm stones, suns itself on them and squeezes its prey in its coils.

creatures.name: Water Snake
creatures.art: olive with dark bands, flat head

theme.notes: An olive water snake with dark crossbands and a flat head, swimming the shallows of wetland and coast in an S, hunting fish among the reeds.

creatures.name: Night Heron
creatures.art: stout, hunched, black cap, red eye

theme.notes: Stout hunched night heron with a black cap, glowing red eye and white plume: freezes in the moonlit shallows, then stabs and gulps fish whole.

creatures.name: Egret Flock
creatures.art: snow white, long plumes, yellow bill

theme.notes: Snow-white egrets with long lacy plumes and yellow dagger bills, wading high-stepping through wetland shallows and following the cattle.
A troop of grey-brown mountain macaques with bare pink faces and short tails: snow monkeys that soak in steaming hot springs, stuff their cheek pouches and flash an open-mouth threat.

creatures.name: Tanuki
creatures.art: round, masked, a leaf on its head

theme.notes: A round masked tanuki from folk tales: a leaf on its head lets it shape-shift into a leaf, a stump or a kettle, and it drums on its round belly. The thing to draw is the dark mask and the leaf.

creatures.name: Burrowing Owl
creatures.art: long legs, sandy spotted, round head

theme.notes: Burrowing owl: a small sandy spotted owl on long legs with a round head, white brows and yellow eyes, bobbing at the mouth of its burrow.
A gang of small grey badger cubs from a grassland sett: the thing to draw is the white face with two black stripes over the eyes; they jostle, pile on each other and tumble.

creatures.name: Mud Crab Brawler
creatures.art: dark mud-brown shell, heavy blunt claws

theme.notes: Dark mud-brown brawler of wetland and coast with heavy blunt crusher claws held up like boxing mitts; lobs mud and regrows a lost claw.

creatures.name: Bramble Pup Pack
creatures.art: small, grey, burrs in the fur

theme.notes: A pack of small grey forest pups that live under the brambles: fluffy balls with burrs stuck all over them, tumbling out of the thicket.

creatures.name: Thorn Jackal
creatures.art: rangy, sandy, thorns in the coat

theme.notes: A rangy sandy jackal of thorn scrub and desert, its coat full of pale thorns: it lopes, waits a very long time, snaps, and licks its wounds clean.
Small russet kestrel that hangs dead still in the wind with its tail fanned, wings flickering, then stoops on its prey.

creatures.name: Snapper Hatchling Bask
creatures.art: small, soft-shelled, sitting on a log

theme.notes: Walnut-sized soft-shelled snapping-turtle hatchlings basking in a row on a log: hooked beaks that snap far above their size, an egg tooth still on the tip, mud stirred up when they slide in.

A slim russet roebuck of forest edge and bracken with short sharp three-point antlers and a white rump that flashes when it bounds; in the rut bucks lock antlers and stamp, and the roe has twin spotted fawns hidden in the bracken.
A stocky, spotted, olive-grey fishing cat of wetland and mangrove: it wades and dives, its webbed paws scooping fish out of the water, and its dense coat sheds the wet.

creatures.name: Tree Monitor
creatures.art: green, long tail, clinging to a branch

theme.notes: A slim green tree monitor of forest and island canopies that lies flat along a branch with its long tail curled round it, then drops onto prey from above.

creatures.name: Water Monitor
creatures.art: dark, long, swimming with the tail

theme.notes: A long dark water monitor of wetland and coast that swims with its tail sculling side to side and wallows in mud with only its eyes showing.
A spotted grassland hyena: sloping back, big head with round ears and a dark muzzle, jaws that crack bone; it runs in a giggling pack and never forgets who wronged it.

creatures.name: Ratel Pair
creatures.art: grey back, black belly, loose skin

theme.notes: A pair of grassland honey badgers, grey-white mantle over a black body, loose tough skin they can twist inside, long digging claws; fearless, tireless, they always come back for more.

creatures.name: Emu Mob
creatures.art: shaggy brown, long neck, a dozen birds

theme.notes: A mob of a dozen shaggy brown emus with long necks and blue throats: they stampede, kick with huge three-toed feet and raise dust.

creatures.name: River Otter
creatures.art: sleek, brown, whiskers, sliding on belly

theme.notes: A sleek brown river otter with bristling whiskers that toboggans down muddy banks on its belly, plays tug and toss with fish and stacks the bank with sticks and stones.
A dark, thick night adder of grassland and desert with a zigzag down its back and red eyes; it lies on warm roads at night and strikes from an S-coil.

creatures.name: Termite Column
creatures.art: pale soft bodies, big brown heads

theme.notes: Termite column: pale soft workers and big brown-headed soldiers that drum their heads, building clay mound spires; they travel in tunnels.

A long dark-brown fisher of the northern forest with a grizzled head and a long bushy tail: it bounds in arcs, comes down trees head first, and is the one hunter that dares porcupines, flipping them over to reach the soft belly.

creatures.name: Warthog
creatures.art: grey, tusks up, tail up, bristly mane

theme.notes: A grey grassland warthog with warts, upturned tusks and a wiry tawny mane; it trots off with its tail held straight up like an antenna and shoves through mud.
A work gang of small dark muskrats with thin scaly tails: they swim low with a V wake, chisel reeds with orange teeth, build reed lodges and weave reed mats, and smell of musk.

creatures.name: Capybara Herd
creatures.art: big, calm, barrel body, birds on back

theme.notes: A big calm herd of barrel-bodied capybaras with little yellow birds riding on their backs; they plod, they float with only eyes, ears and nostrils above water, and nothing ever hurries them.

A brown pangolin of grassland and forest covered in overlapping plates: it walks upright on its hind legs with the tail held out, rolls into a hard scale ball when threatened, and licks ants out of termite mounds with a very long tongue.

creatures.name: Wildcat
creatures.art: striped grey tabby, thick ringed tail

theme.notes: A grey striped wildcat of forest edge and grassland, like a big tabby: the thing to draw is the thick blunt tail with dark rings and a black tip; it bristles, flattens its ears and hisses.

creatures.name: Turkey Vulture
creatures.art: red bare head, dark wings, wobbling glide

theme.notes: Turkey vulture: dark wings with silver flight feathers held in a shallow V, teetering on the wind, a tiny bare red head; it rides thermals and hisses.
Round, fluffy brown bear cubs of forest and mountain that curl into balls and roll downhill, raid hives for honey and get chased by the bees.
A stampede of rust-coloured grassland bison calves with oversized dark woolly heads and shoulder humps; they charge head-down, plant their heads, and bellow for the herd.
Giant banded snail: a huge glossy yellow-brown shell with a dark spiral band, rolling slowly through rainforest leaf litter on a slimy foot.
Army ants: dark-red ants with huge pale sickle jaws in an endless flooding file; at rest they hook together into a living wall.
Sacred scarab: a gold-green beetle pushing a huge ball like the sun, head down and stubborn.
Glowworm queen: big glowing lamps swinging on long threads over a curtain of beaded silk in a mountain cave.
Huge golden orb weaver: long jointed legs and a long gold body walking on strong golden silk that glints in the sun.
Mud dauber: slim black thread-waisted wasps hauling mud balls and building organ-pipe mud tubes.
An orange-and-brown striped rainforest leech that waits on wet leaf tips and drops onto whatever passes; often two drop at once.
A grey-green, salt-dusted leech of brackish marsh pools: it swims in an S wave, salt grains on its back, regrows lost segments and bristles with salt crust.
A round black-capped tundra lemming that is always cross: scowling brows, puffed cheeks, bared buck teeth, a little storm cloud of a mood; it digs into the snow to sulk and stares you down.
A round grey-brown pika with round ears and no tail, sitting sentry on a boulder in the scree: it calls a sharp eep, pitches stones and carries mouthfuls of hay and flowers to its haypile.
A fat, summer-fed golden marmot that stands tall with a dark face mask and pale belly: it whistles alarms, shoves turf about and simply drops its whole weight on things.
Common olive-green shore crab of the tideline: shuffles sideways, digs into wet sand until only the eyestalks show, raises and clacks its claws as a warning.
Pale sand-coloured night beach crab with huge black eyes on stalks: runs so fast it seems to vanish, lives in burrows and flicks rolled sand balls.

creatures.name: Land Crab March
creatures.art: red, broad, in a long line

theme.notes: Broad scarlet land crabs on their great migration from the rainforest to the sea: a long red line over roads and roots, shaking eggs into the surf.
A big-eared desert pack rat with bulging cheeks that hoards shiny things in a stick midden, always dropping what it carries to take something shinier.
A crew of black ship rats with bead eyes and long pink tails: they run the hawsers, swing on the ropes, gnaw the hold and shove the gangplank; smells of tar and bilge.
A slim sand-gold lizard of hot stones: it basks flat in the sun, darts in a sprawl stride through the heat shimmer and drops its tail when caught.
A blue-grey mountain agama with a bright orange head: it does push-ups on warm rocks to show off, then presses itself flat against the stone and vanishes.
A green rainforest basilisk with a tall crest and very long toes: it rears up and sprints across the water on its hind legs, a splash at every step.
A brown dry-forest lizard with a huge collar: when cornered it snaps the frill open like an umbrella round a gaping yellow mouth, hisses, and fans the dust.
A small eyeless desert golden mole that swims through loose sand with a leathery nose pad, its fur shimmering iridescent gold-green; it finds prey by feeling vibrations.
A huge black raven pair of the high crags, face to face and bowing in turn; hoarse croaking voices, great fingered wings, tough hide.
Glossy blue-black rainforest crow with a massive arched bill: a fruit thief that glides out of the canopy and heals on stolen fruit.
Herring gull: a big white seaside gull with grey wings, black wingtips and a yellow bill with a red spot; a loud chip thief that raids the bins.
Tern squadron: slim white terns with black caps, red bills and long forked tails, flying in formation and plunging for fish.
Skua raider: a heavy brown sea pirate with white wing flashes and a hooked bill; it chases other birds until they drop their catch.
Sandy desert scorpion: comes up out of the dunes, tail curled over in a question mark, claws forward; sand everywhere.
Vinegaroon: slim black body, two big feeler arms, a long thin whip tail; sprays sour vinegar mist and sidles at dusk.
A white tundra hare with black ear tips and frost in its fur: it bounds in huge arcs leaving Y-shaped tracks, jinks in zigzags, thumps a warning and breathes frost.
A grey-brown hill hare with long ears and big pale feet: it lies pressed into its form (a scraped hollow) all day, grazes clover at dusk and naps in its hollow; when it runs it lopes uphill.
A lean, long-legged desert jackrabbit with enormous ears that glow pink with red veins in the sun: it sprints low and straight, hides in thorny scrub with only the ear tips showing.
Giant forest centipede: a long orange body rippling in an S, yellow legs, big poison fangs at the head; very fast.
Pale eyeless cave centipede: a slower, ghost-white sibling of the giant centipede with huge legs; drops from the roof among dripping stalactites.
Huge black millipede with red legs: glossy coils that unroll into a wave of legs and curl back up; slow and heavy, poison mist when startled.

A round green barrel cactus of the desert that walks on stubby feet: ribbed sides bristling with cream spines, a crown of pink flowers on top, and a middle full of stored water; it can sink into the sand to hide or tip over and roll.
Ember beetles: a swarm of small beetles glowing like live coals, sparks lifting, a scorched track behind.
Frost beetles: blue-white glinting domes that skate on ice, rime needles on their backs, frost creeping where they pass.
Lava beetles: heavy black plates split by glowing red cracks, magma oozing, heat shimmer; stubborn and unstoppable.

Ball lightning off the coast and islands: a blue-white crackling ball that drifts low with the wind, tendrils of spark snapping round it, forked bolts jumping from it, and a squall of slanting rain following it, which it drinks.
A slim, long, bright-green rainforest snake that drapes from boughs like a vine and hides among leaves until one of the leaves strikes.
A small, clever rainforest capuchin with a cream face and shoulders under a dark cap: it picks pockets, steals shiny buttons and pelts you with fruit from the canopy.
Two fluffy russet fox kits from a tundra den, all big dark-tipped ears and white muzzles: they never stop play-fighting, pouncing on each other, nipping ears and tumbling.
A tiny pale desert fennec that is mostly ears: two huge pink-lined ears swivel to hear prey under the sand; it hunts at night, digs in a blink and sleeps curled in its burrow.
A band of rainforest coatis walking in a line with their long ringed tails held straight up like flags, rooting under logs and leaf litter with long, upturned snouts.
Snowy owl scout: a white black-flecked tundra owl with big yellow eyes, sitting dead still on the snow, then dropping silently on its prey.

Small grey-brown arctic fox kits with round ears from a tundra den: they pop out of the den holes, tumble over each other, yip, and practise the mouse dive, arcing up and plunging nose-first into the snow.

A pure white winter arctic fox that is almost invisible on the snow: all anyone sees are two black eyes and a black nose moving in a blizzard, ears cutting through a drift, and jaws snapping out of nowhere.
A dark island stink badger (teledu) with a white stripe down its back: it raises its rump and sprays musk, then sleeps off any trouble; the forest reeks round it.

creatures.name: Desert Spadefoot
creatures.art: round, tan, a black spade on each foot

theme.notes: A round tan desert toad with a black horny spade on each hind foot: it shovels itself backwards into the sand, sleeps through the dry season and wakes all at once when the first rain falls.
Small sea-blue crab squire with a patched shell and proudly polished claws: carries a limpet as a buckler and charges stubbornly into the tide.
Huge blue-purple robber crab of the island palms with oversized claws and orange legs: climbs palms, cracks coconuts and sneaks off with anything shiny.
A big grey ball of down with huge yellow eyes: clumsy, wobbling, feathered feet too big for it; it hisses and screeches when cross (enrage) in tundra snow.
Mountain buzzard: a broad mottled-brown hawk on very wide rounded wings, circling the ridges in thermals, its shadow sweeping the ground.
A long, low, plain-coated jaguarundi with a small round head and a long tail: the otter-cat of riverbanks and tall grass, slipping past unseen and chirping to its kind.
A vine-thin bright-green tree snake with a pointed snout and a horizontal keyhole pupil; it holds its body out stiff like a twig, sways with the leaves and leans out to strike.
A cinnamon-red island monitor with clove-dark spots and a saffron throat; it smells of spice and leaves a trail of spice dust that stings.
A gangly young komodo of island beaches: sand-spotted, big-headed, with a long yellow forked tongue it never stops flicking; it trips, hides in sand and drools.

A smoky grey snow leopard cub of the high crags with dark rosettes, big fluffy paws and a huge thick ringed tail it swishes, chases and wraps over its nose to sleep; impatient, it always pounces too early.
A grey, black-striped desert and mountain hyena with a long mane down its back that it raises to look twice its size; a quiet scavenger that drags bones away.

A sand-coloured desert viper with a small horn over each eye; it shimmies sideways down into the sand until only the horns and eyes show, and warns by rubbing its saw-edged scales together in C-shaped coils.
A grey, rock-patterned, flat-headed mountain viper that lies among the scree like one more stone; tough-hided, it basks on hot rock and bites whatever sits on it.

A herd of shaggy yak calves from the high cold grassland: long fur skirts sway to the ground, wide cream horns are already growing, breath steams in the thin air and they grunt and bleat as they plod on in file, nobody giving way.
A lean ginger outback dingo with pale socks, pricked ears and a white-tipped bushy tail; it lopes for miles through red dust, circles its prey, and howls instead of barking.
A hermit crab that cannot stop collecting: its shell is piled with bottle caps, sea glass and coins, it staggers under the load and keeps spare shells.
An orange hermit crab living in half a coconut shell: rolls and thumps about on island sand and forest floor, sips coconut milk to heal (drain).
Flat dark-red wedge-shaped rock crab of island reefs: wary, it lives in rock cracks and pools and pinches from a crevice.
A pale-faced sea otter with a bandit mask that floats on its back in the kelp, cracks shellfish on a stone on its tummy and keeps a favourite pebble in its armpit pocket; steals pails.
A small pale desert sidewinder that moves sideways in loops, leaving J-shaped tracks in the sand, with little horns over its eyes for burying itself.
A thin, pale, striped desert-and-coast racer, the fastest snake on the dunes: a straight streak, a spit of venom, gone into the heat mirage.
A tiny jewel-bright blue rainforest frog with black spots and yellow flashes: the colours are the warning, the skin is the poison, and gnomes tip their darts with it.
A tiny bright golden-orange frog of island rainforest moss: it gleams like marmalade, skips over moss cushions, and its bright skin is a warning.
Leafcutter column: rust ants marching under raised green leaf pieces; scissor jaws cut crescents (they chirp as they cut).
Round white tundra ptarmigan with a black eye bar and red comb: hides by sinking into the snow, flushes with a whirr, brown in summer.
Grey rock partridge covey with a black necklace, barred flanks and red legs: runs uphill rather than flies, scratching in mountain and desert grit.
A long silver-green garfish with needle jaws full of teeth and bony diamond scales: it skims just under the surface and leaps out flashing.
A heavy, slow beaded lizard (Gila kin) of desert and dry forest, its hide rows of orange and black beads; it does not strike, it bites, clamps on and chews its venom in.
A gang of small white mountain goat kids with horn buds: they boing straight up on stiff legs, stand on each other's backs, perch on impossible ledges and butt heads all day, knocking pebbles loose.

A stout dark wolverine cub of tundra and mountain with a cream stripe down each flank and a pale brow: a small bully that shoves, snarls, rolls in the snow and steals anything from a camp, boots included.
Cormorant line: dark cormorants with snake necks, hooked bills and emerald eyes, lined up on a post holding their wings out to dry, then diving low in the water.
Booby colony: white seabirds on bright blue feet, strutting and lifting each foot high, plunging for fish from the cliff and crusting the rocks with guano.

A pale tree anteater (tamandua) of the rainforest wearing a black vest, with a long tube snout, a pink tongue for ants, hooked fore-claws and a gripping tail; cornered, it hangs by the tail and spreads its arms wide. The forest calls it the stinker.
Carpenter bee: round glossy blue-black bee that hovers then darts, drilling perfectly round holes in wood.
A plain tawny caracal of desert scrub with very long black ear tufts that it flicks to signal; it leaps straight up to swat birds out of the air and rests in the grass at dusk.
A small, black rainforest sun bear with a pale gold muzzle and a gold crescent on its chest like a rising sun: it climbs, rips bark with long claws and licks honey with a very long tongue.
A raft of round white harp-seal pups with huge dark eyes, bobbing together off a rocky coast; they slap the water with their little flippers and squeak.
A small round blue-white cub of the glacier with frost crystals on its crown: it belly-slides on the ice, skids on all fours and fluffs itself into a frosty fur ball.
A heavy grey bull seal with a thick scarred neck that hauls out on the ice floes of the tundra coast; galumphs on its belly and flies into a rage when cornered.
A knobbly, fluffy desert camel calf on stilt legs it has not learned to use, with a little fluffy hump, long eyelashes against the sand, and a habit of spitting cud.

A small herd of fuzzy brown reindeer calves with two velvet antler buds each and cream muzzles: they huddle rump to rump in the snow, butt with their buds, bleat for each other and trot with clicking knees.

creatures.name: Jaguar Cub Pair
creatures.art: small, spotted, big paws, stubby tail

theme.notes: Two small spotted jaguar cubs with oversized paws and stubby tails: they play-wrestle, chase their own tails, roll in mud and steal bootlaces.

creatures.name: Cloud Kite
creatures.art: forked red tail, pale head, long wings

theme.notes: Long-winged red kite with a pale head and deep forked tail riding mountain updrafts and storm fronts; steals food on the wing.

entries.name: Cold Puddle Lunge
entries.note: override: puddle lunge: ripple rings off a puddle (best guess); palette art-word

th.note: Cold Puddle Lunge: slugs lunge out of a cold puddle, drops flicked off

entries.name: Cave Mouth Chill
entries.note: override: cave-mouth chill: cold breath mist puff, differs from the two slashes; palette art-word

th.note: Cave Mouth Chill: cold cave breath curls off the edge, frost specks at the tips
Glimmer Shroud: hollow glassy outlines line the edge, a glint crossing them

entries.name: Puddle Shapeshift
entries.note: override: slime shapeshift: pale ooze drips, not a shock; palette art-word

th.note: Puddle Shapeshift: the slug melts to a puddle and re-forms at spot after spot
Glow Ooze: see-through slugs rise off the edge, their glow cores brightening, a dotted afterglow behind
Pale Sheen: the pale slugs slip out and back, fading half away, white sheen flecks where they were
Cold Lunge: one ghost slug lunges along the whole edge in a cold haze
Drift Veil: a veil of cold breath curls up and drifts out and back
Lantern Ribbon Sweep: moths sweep off the edge trailing their long tail ribbons

entries.name: Milk-Pale Gust
entries.note: override: gust of wind: puffs, differs from Ribbon Sweep (both slash); palette art-word

th.note: Milk-Pale Gust: a wingbeat gust blows pale crescents and scale powder off
Table-Mat Wing Shield: wings spread flat along the edge like table mats
Lantern Glow Decoy: eyespot moths flash at decoy spots

entries.name: Moon Veil
entries.note: override: moonlit veil: shimmer sparkles, differs from Trailing Tails/Gust puffs; palette art-word

th.note: Moon Veil: pale crescents drift out in a haze and draw back

entries.name: Trailing Tails
entries.note: override: long trailing tails drifting: leaf-drift ribbons (best guess); palette art-word

th.note: Trailing Tails: moths swirl out and back, tails streaming
Wing Buffet: huge pale wings slam out, scale powder bursting
Lunar Hush: moon crescents hang still along the edge in a quiet haze
Matron Pincer Clamp: big chestnut forceps lunge out and clamp
Brood Guard Lunge: her forceps sweep the edge in front of the brood
Egg Cradle Shield: pale egg clutches line the edge, jostled as she shields them
Clutch Decoy: egg clutches blink at decoy spots
Brood Tend: eggs rise licked clean, little shines blinking on them
Egg Shell Ward: forceps bristle out over the clutch like a ring of spikes
Matron Pincer: forceps clamp at spots, tied together in a snare line

entries.name: Egg Cushion
entries.note: override: soft egg cushion: puffs, differs from Brood Tend (both mend); heal override, best guess; palette art-word

th.note: Egg Cushion: soft eggs settle along the edge in a cushion, soft puffs
